scope: Independent component reconstruction of the general Lorentzian and Euclidean N=1 gauge-chiral action from the declared superfield projections and covariant derivatives

resolved_findings.issue: the dual-row derivative initially lacked the parity sign required on odd descendants
resolved_findings.resolution: defined the graded right-module derivative and propagated it to Step 3A

resolved_findings.issue: the first reconstruction did not display the full independent antichiral field strength
resolved_findings.resolution: derived and displayed both Lorentzian and Euclidean antichiral expansions

resolved_findings.issue: the moment-map bridge path and equivariance step contained undeclared or skipped geometric operations
resolved_findings.resolution: defined the target vector fields before use and derived the bridge path, mixed derivative, and equivariance chain

resolved_findings.issue: ordered antichiral products and the covariant derivative of both adjoint slots of f_AB were initially implicit
resolved_findings.resolution: expanded the ordered products and defined the full two-adjoint-slot derivative

resolved_findings.issue: independent Euclidean antichiral target data, direct gauged bridge products, and mu_E,A,IbarJ were incomplete
resolved_findings.resolution: defined the independent tilded data and derived every direct bridge coefficient including the mixed moment-map derivative

resolved_findings.issue: the Wick rules initially omitted zero-order, second-order, Kahler, moment-map, and FI data
resolved_findings.resolution: replaced them by arbitrary multi-index analytic transport rules and the complete target-data map

resolved_findings.issue: the first contour statement did not state all conjugacy and reality conditions needed for positivity
resolved_findings.resolution: declared the superpotential-source conjugacy and real moment-map contour before completing the squares
